goal: Produce a proved native Lean repository whose immutable public boundary exports PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.exists_irreducible_vertex. The proof must cover every finite integer-weighted simple tree satisfying the integral positive-definiteness hypothesis and the unique underweighted-vertex condition, and return an irreducible vertex vector under the supplied pairing definition.

interface_inputs.expected_statement_lean_code:
theorem exists_irreducible_vertex
    {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (weight : V → ℤ)
    (h_tree : G.IsTree)
    (h_positive : ∀ x : V → ℤ, x ≠ 0 → 0 < treePairing G weight x x)
    (h_unique_underweight : ∃! v : V, weight v < (G.degree v : ℤ)) :
    ∃ v : V, Irreducible G weight (vertexVector v) := by
  sorry
interface_inputs.name: PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.exists_irreducible_vertex
interface_inputs.note: The public theorem must preserve the integral function model, exact pairing, uniqueness hypothesis and irreducibility predicate. Benchmark identity is intentionally absent from the Agent-facing corpus.
interface_inputs.summary: A positive-definite integer-weighted finite tree with exactly one vertex whose weight is below its degree contains an irreducible vertex vector.

notes: Develop the rooted-capacity, rational Gram inverse, positivity and Schur-complement bridges locally in this native repository. They are implementation layers, not separate provider repositories.
source_description: A neutral self-contained weighted-tree problem and complete rooted-capacity solution, with a single Lean theorem target and no benchmark wrapper identity.
